name: Taira no Atsumori
source:
Taira no Atsumori is the youngest child of Taira no Tsunemori, the half-brother of Kiyomori, a military commander of the Heike family. While many of the family were in official positions, Atsumori, who had not yet taken the official position, was also called "Unofficial Taifu".

He is a serious, polite person, and although he is a little stiff, he is the youngest in the Heike family, and his appearance remains young.
